title: MoR4Rec: Mixture-of-Recursion for Sequential Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2611.29462v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sequential recommender systems aim to predict a user's next interaction by modeling temporal dependencies in historical behavior sequences. To capture such dependencies, recent approaches increasingly rely on attention-based architectures, particularly transformers. While effective at modeling long-range sequential patterns, these models apply a fixed computation depth to all interaction items, treating them as equally complex. However, user behavior is inherently heterogeneous, with many interactions following simple repetitive patterns, whereas others require modeling higher-order dependencies. This mismatch leads to inefficient utilization of model capacity and unnecessary computational overhead, particularly in deep transformer-based architectures. translated_title: MoR4Rec：面向序列推荐的递归混合模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.29462v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：序列推荐系统旨在通过建模用户历史行为序列中的时序依赖关系来预测用户的下一次交互。为了捕捉这种依赖关系，近期的相关方法越来越依赖于基于注意力的架构，尤其是Transformer。尽管这类模型在建模长程序列模式方面十分有效，但它们对所有交互物品都施加固定的计算深度，将其视为同等复杂。然而，用户行为本质上是异构的：许多交互遵循简单、重复的模式，而另一些交互则需要建模高阶依赖关系。这种不匹配导致了模型容量的低效利用和不必要的计算开销，尤其是在基于深度Transformer的架构中。为解决这一问题，我们提出了MoR4Rec，一种基于递归混合范式的序列推荐框架，它通过共享的Transformer……（摘要截断于此）
tldr: 该论文提出MoR4Rec，一种基于递归混合范式的序列推荐框架，通过为不同复杂度的物品自适应分配计算深度，解决了传统Transformer对所有交互物品采用固定计算深度所导致的模型容量浪费与计算开销过高的问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes MoR4Rec, a sequential recommendation framework based on the Mixture-of-Recursion paradigm that enables item-wise adaptive computation, addressing the inefficiency and unnecessary computational overhead of applying fixed computation depth to all items in Transformer-based recommenders.
